title: Sable and the Bell
author: Paloma Yarrow
blurb: Kestrel Vane, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
